metadata.title: SINT S.r.l. — Security engineering since 1990
metadata.description: Since 1990 SINT has designed security and building systems for companies and public bodies: risk assessment, tender specifications, design, works supervision and acceptance testing.

title: Security
engineering.
hero.copy: SINT supports companies and public bodies with risk assessment, security systems design, works supervision and acceptance testing.

title: Knowledge is the
key to success.
paragraphs: SINT was founded in January 1990 to address security challenges, building on the expertise of its founder, Mario Vago, who had previously held senior roles at major companies in the sector.
Today SINT studies, designs, delivers and implements specialist integrated-security projects, electrical systems and HVAC, with the aim of reducing risk and containing costs.

items.title: Risk management
items.text: We assess the risks to sites and facilities and define security strategies with integrated solutions tailored to the client's needs.

items.title: Tender specifications and bid comparison
items.text: We draft precise, unambiguous technical and functional specifications, the basis for choosing the right suppliers, and compare the bids received.

items.title: Systems design
items.text: Civil and industrial design of security, electrical and building control systems, following established standards and current regulations.

items.title: Centralised monitoring
items.text: We design the centralisation of integrated security systems, with local, regional and national monitoring: for Terna, across more than 100 strategic sites.

items.title: Building automation
items.text: Feasibility studies for building automation, based on the real operating needs of the people who use the building, through to detailed design.

items.title: Cabling and networking
items.text: In partnership with Leviton, a certified global manufacturer, we design and deliver cabling and networking solutions integrated into the overall systems design.

items.title: Works supervision
items.text: We monitor and coordinate the contractors and manage the contractual relationship with them on the client's behalf, taking full responsibility.

items.title: Acceptance testing
items.text: We verify that every part of the supply is complete and working as contracted, issuing the required reports at each stage.

caseStudies.description: Tender specifications, tender management, design, design review and works supervision for intrusion detection, access control and CCTV systems, with national centralised monitoring.
Risk assessment and design of security and CCTV systems for the postal sorting centres.
Risk assessment, security systems design, works supervision and acceptance testing at the Florence production site and the Milan showroom.
Technical and functional review and detailed design of fire protection, voice evacuation, CCTV, intrusion detection and access control systems.
Definitive design for upgrading the CCTV systems of Casa Museo Boschi, the Modern Art Gallery, Museo del Novecento and Palazzo Reale.
Delivery of the CCTV and perimeter protection systems.

title: From Meda,

contact.copy: SINT's registered and operational office is in Meda (MB), north of Milan. We work with companies and public bodies throughout Italy.
